result.topic_en: Euler notes that his small-deflection estimate of the deflection Dδ is impossibly large because it assumes infinitely small bending, then announces an analysis of the column buckling rule for cylindrical columns of constant stiffness and later of variable thickness, and begins setting up the problem of a slightly bent loaded cylindrical column AMC.
